extName.message: Future Me – pause before you pay

extDescription.message: Pauses you at checkout and shows what the money could become. Purchases stay in your browser; only anonymous totals are shared.

headline.message: $1. Is it worth what it could become?

headlineProduct.message: $1 on $2. Is it worth what it could become?

disclaimer.message: Illustration at $1% a year, a long-run average for global shares. Not financial advice: returns vary and can be negative.

whyNow.message: Why do you want it right now?

pickReason.message: Pick a reason to unlock “Buy anyway”.

moveItForReal.message: The jar only counts. Make it real: move the amount to your savings account or broker.

waitHeadline.message: Parked. We'll ask again in $1 hours.

waitBody.message: If you still want it then, buy it with a clear head. Any countdown timer on this page will be gone by then. That's the point.

popupTopReason.message: Most common reason when you buy anyway: $1

popupWaitEmpty.message: Nothing parked. Hit “Wait” in the pause to park a purchase.

popupNoShop.message: Open a webshop to manage it here.

optIntro.message: Future Me pauses you at the moment you commit money in a webshop, and shows what that money could become. Nothing leaves your browser.

optRate.message: Yearly return used for the illustration

optRateHelp.message: 7% is a common long-run average for global shares. Lower it for a more cautious picture.

optCartHelp.message: Off by default: the pause comes at “Buy now”, checkout and “Place order”.

optReason.message: Ask for a reason before “Buy anyway”

optReasonHelp.message: A small bit of friction. Your reasons show up as a pattern in the toolbar popup.

optSavingsHelp.message: The page or app link where you move money, e.g. your bank's savings page or your broker. Opens after you skip a purchase.

optShopsHelp.message: Future Me watches large shops such as Amazon, bol, Coolblue and Zalando out of the box. Add any other shop from the toolbar button while you're on it.

optOff.message: Shops where you switched it off

optDataHelp.message: Your jar, cooling-off list and decisions are stored only in this browser. Uninstalling removes them.

optResetConfirm.message: Reset your jar, cooling-off list and history?

passToast.message: Future Me: same basket, go ahead. Free pass for $1 more min.

optPassHelp.message: The next steps of the same checkout go through without a new pause, as long as the total stays the same (up to €10 extra for shipping). Add or change something and the pause comes back.

qrTitle.message: Make it real: scan with your banking app

qrSteps.message: Open your banking app, choose to scan a QR code, check the details and confirm.

qrSafe.message: You confirm the transfer in your own banking app. Future Me never connects to your bank.

qrLater.message: Later, keep it in the jar

optTransferHelp.message: After you skip a purchase, Future Me can show a payment QR code. Your banking app scans it and opens a transfer that's already filled in to the account below. You always confirm it yourself, in your own app.

optIbanHelp.message: Your savings account, or your broker's deposit IBAN. In Trade Republic you'll find it under Transfer → Add money → Bank transfer. Brokers usually only accept money from an account in your own name.

optIbanBad.message: This IBAN doesn't look right. Check for a typo.

optStatsHelp.message: Helps show how much Future Me users keep in their pockets. Sends a random install code, the shop's domain and the amount when you skip or move money. Never the product, page, name or IBAN. Switch it off any time.
